title: Ken Paxton, G.O.P. Nominee in Texas, Privately Said Trump’s Convention Hurt Him
summary: Ken Paxton, one of the party’s top Senate candidates and a Trump loyalist, said that “everybody’s numbers dropped” after the event, according to audio obtained by The Times.
